scenes.summary: Tianshi Shang Jin and Tianshi Mo Yu are arguing because they lack enough Xiranite to activate the Bell of Three Presences. You agree to help them by providing sufficient Xiranite to activate the runes on the bell.

lines.text: I-I've had enough of your nonsense! H-how can you be such a *Yanese Expletive*?
Come again?! This was never our business to begin with.
Oh great, your loud mouth just invited everyone to the circus.
This is between me and him. P-please stay out of it.
W-wait, wait a minute... That dark mask of yours...
Are... Are you the Endministrator?
It's s-s-so great to see you! I-I heard the AIC Factory from Endfield can now p-produce Xiranite!
C-could you ... lend us some?
Endministrator, allow me to explain. Shang Jin tends to stutter when he's nervous.
I'm Mo Yu. We're the Tianshi responsible for transporting Xiranite to the ⟦key|Bell of Three Presences⟧.
After being modified by HAS, this ancient Yanese bell now runs on Xiranite, powering its runes to detect Blight and issue early warnings.
You might've seen similar ones around Wuling City.
But ... as you know, our Xiranite reserves are nearly gone. And since this bell sits in the city's inner ring...
Its Xiranite allocation priority is lower than the others. Supply skips us most of the time, and we've been waiting ages for nothing.
Still, w-we can't just sit here and t-twiddle our thumbs! As Tianshi, we're obligated t-to do something.
Easy, Shang Jin. See, the Endministrator's here to lend a hand.
R-right! Endministrator, p-please help us.
Simple. There are three ⟦key|runes⟧ carved into this bell. We just have to feed each one enough Xiranite.
⟦key|A thousand⟧.
Th-then we're counting on you, Endministrator!

options: Alright everyone, take a deep breath.
Shhh, I'm trying to lay low.
You're really quick on the news!
What do you need Xiranite for?
Sure. What do you need me to do?
How much Xiranite are we talking?
No problem. Leave it to me.

lines.text: Endministrator, I-I just checked, we need nine pieces of Xiranite t-to fully activate the Bell of Three Presences!
You've got this, Endministrator!
Endministrator, I-I just checked, we need six more pieces of Xiranite t-to fully activate the Bell of Three Presences!
You've got this, Endministrator!
Endministrator, I-I just checked, we just need three more pieces of Xiranite t-to fully activate the Bell of Three Presences!
Just a little more elbow grease, Endministrator!

scenes.summary: You supplied enough Xiranite to fully activate the bell. Both Tianshi are relieved and grateful.

lines.text: Finally! The Bell of Three Presences is ringing again! My stress level just dropped to zero.
Phew, I can breathe freely now. Thank you, truly!
Shang Jin can finally sleep through the night. Thank you, Endministrator.
As for the Xiranite we borrowed, we'll file the paperwork to repay you once supply comes in.
Ah! Th-thank you...
We really appreciate all you've done, Endministrator.

options: No need. Consider it a gift from Endfield.
No rush. I know you've been dealing with a lot.
